name: Peruvian Quinoa Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 small potato (100 g) and 1 carrot, diced
½ cup sweet corn and ½ cup green peas
1 tsp aji amarillo paste or mild chilli
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Add the spices and chilli paste.
Add the potato, carrot and stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the quinoa, corn and beans and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the peas and cook for 3 minutes.
Finish with lime juice, coriander and salt.
note: Quinoa and beans together provide a complete protein with a lot of fibre.
